attacks.name: Martial Arts die
attacks.notes: in place of Unarmed Strike and Monk weapon damage

class_features.name: Martial Arts
class_features.summary: Dex for unarmed and Monk weapons · 1d8 damage · Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action
class_features.full_text:
You gain the following benefits when unarmed or wielding only Monk weapons, provided you aren’t wearing armor or wielding a Shield.

• You can make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action.
• You can roll 1d8 in place of the normal damage from your Unarmed Strikes or Monk weapons.
• You can use Dex. instead of Str. for the attack and damage rolls of your Unarmed Strikes and Monk Weapons. In addition, when you use the Grapple or Shove option of your Unarmed Strike, you can use Dex. instead of Str. to determine the save DC.

class_features.name: Unarmored Defense
class_features.summary: AC 10 + Dex + Wis (14) without armor or a shield
class_features.full_text: While you aren’t wearing armor or wielding a Shield, your base AC equals 14.

class_features.name: Monk’s Focus
class_features.summary: Focus Points fuel Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind, and more
class_features.full_text:
Your focus and martial training allows you to harness a well of energy within yourself called Focus Points. You have 5 Focus Points and regain all expended points after you finish a Short or Long Rest.

You can expend these points to enhance or fuel certain Monk features. You start knowing three such features:

Flurry of Blows. You can expend 1 Focus Point to make two Unarmed Strikes as a Bonus Action.

Patient Defense. You can take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action or expend 1 Focus Point to take both the Disengage and Dodge actions as a Bonus Action.

Step of the Wind. You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action or expend 1 Focus Point to take both the Disengage and Dash actions as a Bonus Action, and your jump distance is doubled for the turn.

Features that use Focus Points may require your target to make a saving throw. The save DC equals 8 + Wis. modifier + Prof. Bonus.

activations.label: Patient Defense
activations.summary: Disengage, or spend 1 Focus to Disengage and Dodge

activations.label: Step of the Wind
activations.summary: Dash, or spend 1 Focus to Disengage and Dash with your jump doubled

class_features.name: Unarmored Movement
class_features.summary: +10 ft speed without armor or a shield
class_features.full_text: Your speed increases by 10 ft. while you aren’t wearing armor or wielding a Shield.

class_features.name: Uncanny Metabolism
class_features.summary: on Initiative, regain all Focus Points and 1d8 + 5 HP, once per long rest
class_features.full_text: Once per Long Rest, when you roll Initiative you can regain all expended Focus Points, and regain 1d8+5 HP.

class_features.name: Deflect Attacks
class_features.summary: reduce the damage by 1d10+10; if reduced to 0, redirect it
class_features.full_text:
When an attack roll that includes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage hits you, you can take a Reaction to reduce the attack’s total damage by 1d10+10.

If you reduce the damage to 0, you can expend 1 Focus Point to redirect some of the attack’s force. If you do, choose a creature you can see within 5 ft. of you if it was melee, or a creature you can see within 60 ft. that isn’t behind Total Cover if the attack was ranged. The creature must succeed on a DC 10 Dex. saving throw or take 2d8+5 damage of the same type dealt by the attack.

class_features.name: Radiant Sun Bolt
class_features.summary: ranged spell attack, 30 ft, 1d8 radiant; twice as a Bonus Action for 1 Focus
class_features.full_text: You gain a special ranged spell attack with a range of 30 ft. that uses your DEX modifier and deals radiant damage equal to your Martial Arts die. When you take the Attack action, you can spend 1 Focus point to make the special attack twice as a bonus action and you can use this attack as any of the attacks using the Extra Attack feature.

class_features.name: Slow Fall
class_features.full_text: You can take a Reaction when you fall to reduce any falling damage by 25.

class_features.name: Extra Attack
class_features.summary: attack twice when you take the Attack action
class_features.full_text: You can attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action.

class_features.name: Stunning Strike
class_features.summary: on a hit, the target makes a Con save or is Stunned until your next turn
class_features.full_text: Once per turn, when you hit with a Monk weapon or Unarmed Strike, you can expend 1 Focus Point to attempt a stunning strike. The target must make a DC 10 Con. saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, the target’s Speed is halved until the start of your next turn, and the next attack roll made against it has Advantage.

racial_traits.name: Resourceful
racial_traits.summary: Heroic Inspiration after each long rest
racial_traits.full_text: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

racial_traits.name: Skillful
racial_traits.full_text: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

racial_traits.name: Versatile
racial_traits.full_text: You gain an Origin feat of your choice.

feats.name: Lucky
feats.summary: spend a point for advantage on your d20, or disadvantage on an attack against you
feats.full_text:
Luck Points. You have 3 Luck Points that you can spend on the benefits below. You regain expended Luck Points after a Long Rest.

Advantage. When you roll a d20 for a D20 Test, you can spend 1 Luck Point to give yourself Advantage on the roll.

Disadvantage. When a creature rolls a d20 for an attack roll against you, you can spend 1 Luck Point to impose Disadvantage on that roll.

feats.name: Savage Attacker
feats.summary: once per turn, roll weapon damage twice and use either roll
feats.full_text: Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon’s damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.
